study_title: DNA features beyond the transcription factor binding sites specify target recognition by plant bHLHs [DAP-seq]
experiment_title: Illumina NovaSeq 6000 sequencing: GSM4699057: DAP-SlMYC2 Solanum lycopersicum OTHER
library_construction_protocol: Genomic DNA extraacted with the CTAB method and RNase A treated gDNA fragmented to 200 bp fragments in average and ligated a a truncated Illumina TruSeq adapter (Y adapter). gDNA library is incubated with recombinant protein expressed in E.coli, previously immobilized with Amylose beads. After binding and washing, DNA is eluted and PCR-amplified with Truseq primers, including a single index.
